jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
The mission of The Lunenburg Public Schools is to provide all students with the skills, confidence, and passion for life-long learning so that they may find their own paths to successful careers, active citizenship, and rewarding lives.

There are open after school program opportunities at the Turkey Hill Elementary School

TITLE: After School Program Instructor
REPORTS TO: Principal

LOCATION
Turkey Hill Elementary School (Grade 3-5), 129 Northfield Road, Lunenburg, MA  01462

DESCRIPTION
Instructors sought for after school activities at the Turkey Hill Elementary School.

After school activities will be determined but possible sessions might include, but not limited to the following:

School council, Origami, Cooking and baking, Poetry 

In your application letter, please describe the activity you proposing for the THES students. 

Each session will run for five weeks--one hour per week (3:15 to 4:15 p.m.). 

As these are self-funded activities, a minimum of 10 participants per activity is required.
If the proposed activity will require supplies, the minimum number of participants will increase to accommodate that additional expense.  
There is some flexibility as to which weekday the activities may be offered - please indicate your weekday preference in your application letter.  

The first round is anticipated to run during the weeks of January 18,25,  and February 1 and 8, and 15.  

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT:
Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.
Stipend payment:  $232.00
